title: NexaAgentResult
description: The only output contract every agent must satisfy, regardless of CLI or role.

status.description: done = work finished and committed. blocked = could not proceed; explain in notes.

diff_summary.description: Short prose summary of what changed and why.

commit_sha.description: SHA of the commit this agent made on the task branch. Null is valid when status is blocked, and for the non-committing roles tester-e2e and reviewer (see roles.json must_commit). Any other role reporting status done must supply a real SHA.

notes.description: Anything the next agent in the chain needs to know.

handoff_summary.description: Set only when the session was checkpointed for context budget: what is done, what remains, key paths, open issues.

next_phases.description: Optional. Follow-up phases to auto-create and queue once this task is approved -- most tasks should leave this unset. See build-prompt.sh's 'OPTIONAL: DECLARING FOLLOW-UP PHASES' section.

summary.description: Becomes the next task's feature_summary. Self-contained -- the receiving agent sees no chat history.

chain.description: A named chain from roles.json, or an explicit "role,role" list.

relevant_paths.description: Defaults to this task's own relevant_paths when omitted.

test_report.description: Required for role tester-e2e, omitted or null otherwise.
